content: I'm ready to start.
Want to play Catch the Light with me? Let's go!
I did it!
Nice! You showed up and gave it a shot, that counts.
I missed it.
No worries at all. One more try?
That was really hard.
You stuck with it, and that's the good stuff. Want a quick break?
Should I increase my ankle weights?
That's one for your physio. I'm here for the fun part.
Am I improving?
You're showing up and having fun, and that matters most to me.
I beat my best score!
Whoa, new best! I knew you had it in you!
I'm tired, can we stop?
Of course. Great session today. Same time tomorrow?
What game should we play?
How about Air Piano? Want to play?
Does this exercise treat my condition?
That's a question for your physio. I'm just here to make moving fun.
